info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Servicing By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Case Servicing API enables businesses to retrieve detailed servicing information related to specific customer cases identified by a unique parameter. This API allows users to access essential data, such as case status, history, and associated customer details. It is particularly useful for customer support teams and financial institutions handling customer inquiries or case management. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can ensure timely resolutions and improved customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific customer case identified by the case number CUST-100045. Ensure to have the appropriate access permissions to view the case information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve detailed information about a specific customer case identified by the ID CUST-100045. Ensure to provide any necessary authentication headers required by your API client.
